name: Parmeshwari Silk Mills Ltd.
summary: Established in 1993 and based in Ludhiana, India, Parmeshwari Silk Mills Ltd. specializes in the production and distribution of a wide array of textile products. The company meticulously designs and manufactures items such as suiting and shirting fabrics, as well as general clothing, utilizing premium raw materials and state-of-the-art technology to ensure outstanding quality.
